name: transfer_to_agent
description: transfer_to_agent: Transfer the call to a live human agent. Provide context so the live agent can pick up the conversation seamlessly.

employee_id.description: The employee's ID. Format: EMP followed by 6 digits. If the caller has not been authenticated, use the ID they provided. Example: EMP048271

issue_summary.description: A brief summary of the caller's request, what was attempted, and why the transfer is needed. This should be in the same language as the conversation you had with the user.
